        triples.append((m.group(1),m.group(2),m.group(3).strip('<>"')))

    for pm in re.finditer(r'\b(a|brick:isPointOf|qudt:hasUnit|qudt:hasQuantityKind|ref:hasExternalReference|ref:hasTimeseriesId|qudt:value|brick:hasArea|ref:ifcName) ("[^"]+"|<[^>]+>|\S+)', ln):
        p=pm.group(1); o=pm.group(2).strip('<>"')
        if subj: triples.append((subj,p,o))

uts={}
for s,p,o in triples:
    if p=='ref:hasTimeseriesId': uts[s]=o
print("uts:", len(uts), list(uts.items())[:3])
